data.long_meaning: In Greek, Timothea means 'honor to God'. This name has biblical roots, as it appears in the New Testament as the name of a female disciple. The name Timothea carries the meaning “Honor to God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Timothea usually hope their child will grow to embody honor to god and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Timothea total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
